deadline_policy.options: Native Options { limits, operation_timeout }; default30seconds. Byte-only Limits structs retain their existing fields/defaults.
deadline_policy.scope: One absolute monotonic deadline covers a complete operation, including setup and all nested stages. New commands receive fresh allowances; idle lifetime is not charged.
deadline_policy.dict: Connect covers DNS/TCP/banner. High-level commands share one deadline across writes, all definitions/text, terminators and final status. Pre-I/O unusable flag remains set after timeout or externally dropped polled future; no further command writes.
deadline_policy.fsp: Connect covers UDP setup/name resolution. Each file/list/request budget spans all sends, retries and blocks. Existing attempts3 and per-reply timeout1second preserved. OperationTimedOut is distinct from existing retry TimedOut. Interrupted or retry-exhausted unanswered requests retire uncertain-key sessions; accepted CC_ERR and post-reply aggregate refusal preserve known-key sessions.
deadline_policy.kepler_text: One fetch allowance covers DNS/TCP/TLS/write/header/body via untimed inner helpers. Supplied-carrier helpers are also bounded. Owned fetch drops transport after timeout/cancellation; borrowed carriers must be discarded by callers.
deadline_policy.scorpion: Options cover TCP fetch or a framed exchange/read. Absolute exchange_until/read_response_until and TLS connect_with_deadline allow one caller deadline across setup and multiple native frames. Borrowed carrier interruption requires caller discard; TLS verifier and resumption policy unchanged.
deadline_policy.preflight: Invalid caller input, zero allowance and unrepresentable durations refuse before timer/network when applicable. Zero gives timeout; overflow is an invalid policy error. Pure preflight remains pollable without a Tokio runtime.
deadline_policy.ready_carriers: Explicit absolute-deadline checks prevent always-ready completion from succeeding after the deadline.
